lines.text: Captain I recommend we raise shields to protect the hull from micro-asteroids
Captain, my sensors are registering a dense field of micro-asteroids. Recommend we raise shields.
It looks like radiation levels are rising... We need to raise shields sir.
Radiation levels are rising. We need to raise shields sir.
The ship we were assigned to protect has been destroyed. Ending simulation.
We have run out of time. Ending simulation.
